claims.statement: Truncated finite block polynomials satisfy the exact count-vector identity and Jensen/Taylor coefficient floor.

claims.reason: Joint-law expansion and Jensen prove the floor informally; two size-one blocks with F1=1+z+z^2 show the exact identity needs support truncation.

claims.reason: Counting subsets of the fixed independent set and one outside singleton proves the floor, with no other graph identities.

limitations: The two guarded shifted-C comparisons have no all-profile proof or guarded counterexample in admitted evidence.
Finite diagnostics, including corrected endpoint coverage, are bounded evidence only.
The selected MASS and exact-ratio payment retain computer-assisted/nonformal status; no governed Lean award was attempted.
The finite-block expectation identity needs factors truncated to their block sizes; coefficient floors extend to extra nonnegative terms.
